## Activity

During November 2022, East City Eye Clinic completed 200 captures. This records the total activity undertaken at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for the subsequent review of image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 200 captures completed, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.5 per cent. This means that the images could not be used for grading in those cases. The rate is reported alongside the number of ungradable captures to provide a clear summary of image quality for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 39 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag from photograph to grade was 2 days. This measure summarises the time between image capture and completion of grading. Together, the referable result count and the median lag provide the monthly grading position for East City Eye Clinic.
